description: LOCATE a known string on a sheet — the complement to read_sheet_text (which returns what a region SAYS; this finds WHERE a string you already know sits). Case-insensitive substring match against each pdf.js text run, so a room label split across runs ("OFFICE" then "134" as separate items) needs a find_text call per fragment, or read_sheet_text over a region to see the whole thing joined. Every hit tells you which room a polygon belongs to — the locate-then-trace workflow: find_text the room number, then measure_polygon (One-Click is temporarily gated on this server) on that room's wall faces. Optionally restrict to a region {x0, y0, x1, y1}; results cap at limit (default 200), with count/truncated telling you exactly how much a tighter region or higher limit would recover. Coordinates are image px at render scale 2.0: PDF pt × 2, origin top-left, y down (the browser canvas's native space). Sheet payloads carry dims in both px and pt.

q.description: Text to find — a room number ('134'), a label fragment ('RECEPTION'), a schedule tag ('CPT-1')

region.description: Rect in image px (origin top-left, y down); omit for the full sheet

name: find_text

count.description: Total matches before the limit cap

center.description: Bbox center, image px — feed straight into one_click's seed

str.description: The matched pdf.js text run, verbatim (may be shorter than the full label — runs aren't merged into lines)

truncated.description: true = count exceeds hits.length; narrow the region or raise limit
